_comment: The catalogue of Central European trees the pipeline grows. One entry per
species; `variants` seeds decide how many differently shaped individuals of
it are built. `tree` is merged onto the base of its kind and handed to
ez-tree, `bark` and `foliage` to the texture painters (lib/bark.mjs,
height: [min, max] in metres over the variants — the model is scaled so the
tallest vertex lands there, and TreeSource.scale varies it further.
crown: crown width as a share of the height; only the impostor quad uses it.
cull: how far the species is drawn [m]; a hazel bush is not worth a draw
call at two kilometres, an oak is.
tags: what the route editor's content drawer and the forest brush filter on.
The `stand-*` tags are the stand types the brush mixes (MODS.md, Trees).
